docs.title: SYNQRA // Neural Retrieval & Attribution Canvas
docs.text: A high-performance, neo-brutalist Archival RAG client engineered in Flutter with low-latency Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, granular document-scoped vector retrieval, grounded citation deep linking, and real-time agentic thought telemetry.

docs.title: Executive Summary
docs.text:
SYNQRA is an archival retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) mobile instrument built for researchers, intelligence analysts, and knowledge architects who require complete transparency, provenance, and attribution when querying dense document stores.

Unlike conventional chatbots that deliver opaque answers with vague references, SYNQRA treats document retrieval and synthesis as an observable scientific process:

  • Incremental Token Streaming: Answers arrive over HTTP SSE with live token-per-second and millisecond latency telemetry.
  • Agentic Thought Timeline: The full retrieval lifecycle—dense embedding generation, HNSW graph traversal, cross-encoder reranking, and context synthesis—is rendered as an interactive live timeline.
  • Interactive Grounded Citations: Claims in generated answers are paired with clickable citation chips ([1], [2]) that expand into grounded source text snippets, page references, and similarity metrics.
  • Multi-Document Scoping: Flexible touch and slide gestures allow scoping inquiries across the entire corpus, a single PDF, or an arbitrary subset of files.
  • Zero-Browser SRP Authentication: Direct AWS Cognito User Pool authentication using the Secure Remote Password (SRP) protocol without webviews or external browser redirects.
  • Archival Neo-Brutalist Visual Identity: High-contrast tactile borders, zero-blur vector graphics, warm parchment and obsidian nocturne palettes, and typewriter terminal animations.

docs.title: Backend API Contract
docs.text: SYNQRA interfaces with FastAPI-based neural retrieval engines. All communications run over encrypted HTTPS in production or local reverse-forwarded ports during development.

docs.title: Production Host Configuration
docs.text:
• Production Base URL: https://synqra-api.duckdns.org
  • Protocol: HTTPS / TLS 1.3
  • Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <CognitoAccessToken>

docs.title: 1. Ingest PDF Document (POST /documents)
docs.text:
Uploads a document for text extraction, chunking, and dense vector embedding.

  • URL: https://synqra-api.duckdns.org/documents
  • Content-Type: multipart/form-data
  • Fields:
  • file: PDF binary stream
  • chunking_strategy: String ("semantic" or "fixed")

docs.title: Response (201 Created)
docs.text:
{
  "document_id": "doc-8f3a12bc",
  "filename": "quantum_error_correction.pdf",
  "chunks": 42,
  "status": "indexed"
}

docs.title: 2. Streaming Retrieval (POST /questions/stream)
docs.text:
Dispatches a scoped natural language query and streams incremental answer tokens and timeline telemetry via Server-Sent Events.

  • URL: https://synqra-api.duckdns.org/questions/stream
  • Content-Type: application/json
  • Accept: text/event-stream

docs.title: Request Payload
docs.text:
{
  "question": "Explain topological surface codes.",
  "document_ids": ["doc-8f3a12bc"],
  "top_k": 5,
  "dense_only": false
}

docs.title: SSE Stream Protocol (text/event-stream)
docs.text:
The server transmits atomic event blocks delimited by double newlines (\n\n):

event: status
data: {"step": "vector_search", "message": "Searching HNSW index for top 5 candidates...", "done": false}

event: answer_chunk
data: {"chunk": "Topological surface codes are "}

event: answer_chunk
data: {"chunk": "quantum error-correcting codes "}

event: citations
data: {"citations": [{"id": 1, "document_id": "doc-8f3a12bc", "filename": "quantum_error_correction.pdf", "page": 4, "text": "Surface codes arrange physical qubits in a 2D square lattice..."}]}

event: done
data: {}

docs.title: 3. Fallback Non-Streaming Retrieval (POST /questions)
docs.text:
Invoked automatically by RagStreamRepository if the streaming endpoint is unreachable or returns 404 Not Found.

  • URL: https://synqra-api.duckdns.org/questions
  • Content-Type: application/json

docs.title: Response (200 OK)
docs.text:
{
  "answer": "Topological surface codes arrange physical qubits on a 2D square lattice [1].",
  "citations": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "document_id": "doc-8f3a12bc",
      "filename": "quantum_error_correction.pdf",
      "page": 4,
      "text": "Surface codes arrange physical qubits in a 2D square lattice..."
    }
  ]
}

docs.title: Ingestion Status Polling & Timeout Handling
docs.text: When a document upload begins: 1. File binary is posted to POST /documents. 2. Initial response yields status: "processing". 3. Client polls GET /documents/{document_id} at 2-second intervals. 4. Asynchronous progress (15%, 45%, 100%) updates the Corpus Repository progress bar. 5. Once indexed, the status transitions to INDEXED (#2E7D32), making the document available for scoped queries.

docs.title: 1. Presentation Layer
docs.text: The presentation layer is built with Flutter declarative widgets coupled with ChangeNotifier providers managed via the provider package.

docs.title: Active Providers
docs.text:
• RagSessionProvider:
  • Manages query dispatch, token buffering, and SSE event streaming.
  • State machine: idle → streaming → completed (or error).
  • Maintains ProcessTimelineStep state to animate the agentic thought timeline.
  • CorpusProvider:
  • Manages active document lists, chunking strategies (semantic vs. fixed), and file uploads.
  • Implements multi-document touch and drag-range selection logic.
  • SettingsProvider:
  • Persists operator credentials, dark mode state, and backend endpoint URLs.
  • Interacts with CognitoAuthRepository to maintain live authentication state.
  • TelemetryProvider:
  • Polling engine collecting retrieval latency metrics, knowledge graph node topologies, and memory health.
  • Exposes AWS CloudWatch operational state, recent audit buffer, and metric dispatch triggers.

docs.title: 2. Domain Layer
docs.text: The domain layer contains pure Dart entities and abstract repository contracts with zero framework dependencies:

docs.title: Key Domain Models
docs.text:
• RagStreamEvent: Sealed class representing atomic stream messages:
  • StreamStatusEvent: Telemetry progress update (step, message, done).
  • AnswerChunkEvent: Incremental token chunk text.
  • CitationsEvent: List of grounded Citation entities.
  • StreamErrorEvent: Network or status error payload.
  • StreamDoneEvent: Stream completion signal.
  • Citation: Source attribution entity containing documentId, filename, page, snippetText, and relevance score.
  • DocumentEntry: File manifest entry tracking upload status, chunk count, file size, and indexing progress.
  • ProfileSettings: Operator configuration including endpoints, theme preference, and clearance data.

docs.title: Abstract Repository Contracts
docs.text:
• IRagStreamRepository: Contract for Server-Sent Events query streaming and fallback.
  • ICorpusRepository: Contract for document uploads, status polling, and manifest retrieval.
  • ICognitoAuthRepository: Contract for AWS Cognito SRP authentication, registration, and logout.
  • ITelemetryRepository: Contract for diagnostic metrics and graph statistics.

docs.title: 3. Data Layer
docs.text: The data layer handles concrete networking, parsing, and storage implementations:

docs.title: Real-Time SSE Stream Parser (RagStreamRepository)
docs.text:
• Connects directly to POST /questions/stream using an HTTP streaming client.
  • Parses line-by-line Server-Sent Events (event: <type>, data: <json>).
  • Emits atomic RagStreamEvent objects onto a Dart StreamController.
  • Automatic Fallback: If the SSE stream fails or returns 404 Not Found, the repository automatically falls back to the standard non-streaming POST /questions endpoint.

docs.title: Encrypted Key-Value Persistence (ProfileSettingsRepository)
docs.text:
• Employs SharedPreferences for general configuration.
  • Integrates FlutterSecureStorage (AES hardware keychain encryption) for bearer access tokens and refresh tokens.

docs.title: 4. Core Layer & Physics
docs.text:
• CloudWatchService: Core telemetry and audit service targeting AWS CloudWatch Logs (/synqra/archival-rag) and Metrics (Synqra/MobileRetrieval) in ap-southeast-2. Implements dynamic AWS SigV4 request signing and maintains a 60-event in-memory ring buffer for offline resilience.
  • AppTheme: Centralized design token system providing Parchment (Light) and Nocturne (Dark) themes with custom typography and hard-edge brutalist shadows.
  • CitationParser: High-performance regex parser that tokenizes answer strings, extracts [1], [2], [1, 2] patterns, and produces formatted spans with interactive badge triggers.
  • SmoothPageRoute: Physics-based transitional routing implementing Curves.easeInOutCubic (260ms duration) with slide-and-fade physics for tactile transitions across canvases.

docs.title: Cognito Authentication & Clearance Ledger
docs.text: SYNQRA incorporates native, in-app authentication powered by the official AWS Amplify Auth Cognito Flutter SDK. Authentication is performed directly through Cognito User Pool APIs using the Secure Remote Password (SRP) protocol, completely eliminating external browser redirects, popups, and managed login webviews.

docs.title: Configuration Details
docs.text: Parameter Configuration Value AWS Region ap-southeast-2 (Sydney) Cognito User Pool ID ap-southeast-2_cR0iLu56D Cognito App Client ID 4p3oehrll2pd9p1ann0gvubp1c Authentication Flow USER_SRP_AUTH (Secure Remote Password) Token Storage Hardware-backed Keychain / Keystore (FlutterSecureStorage)

docs.title: Secure Remote Password (SRP) Flow
docs.text:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Operator as Researcher (App UI)
    participant SDK as Amplify Auth Cognito
    participant Cognito as AWS Cognito User Pool
    participant Storage as FlutterSecureStorage
    participant Backend as FastAPI Backend

    Operator->>SDK: Enter Email & Password
    Note over SDK,Cognito: SRP Protocol Handshake (Zero plain-text transmission)
    SDK->>Cognito: InitiateAuth (USER_SRP_AUTH)
    Cognito-->>SDK: Challenge (PASSWORD_VERIFIER + Salt)
    SDK->>Cognito: RespondToAuthChallenge (HKDF signature)
    Cognito-->>SDK: AuthenticationResult (ID, Access & Refresh Tokens)
    SDK->>Storage: Encrypt & Persist Session
    SDK-->>Operator: Authentication Successful -> Route to RootShellScreen

    Operator->>Backend: Request (e.g. POST /questions/stream)
    Note over Operator,Backend: Header: Authorization: Bearer <AccessToken>
    Backend-->>Operator: 200 OK + Stream

docs.title: 1. In-App Sign-In
docs.text:
• Operator submits credentials on the Archival Clearance Ledger (ClearanceAuthScreen).
  • Invokes Amplify.Auth.signIn(username: email, password: password).
  • If an email verification challenge is pending, the UI routes seamlessly to the verification code modal.
  • On success, SettingsProvider updates researcher display names and call signs, then navigates to RootShellScreen.

docs.title: 2. In-App Registration & Confirmation
docs.text:
• Allows new operators to register directly within the app.
  • Invokes Amplify.Auth.signUp(...).
  • Triggers verification code dispatch via AWS SES / Cognito.
  • Operator enters the 6-digit confirmation code (Amplify.Auth.confirmSignUp(...)).
  • Includes a one-tap RESEND VERIFICATION CODE action.

docs.title: 3. Password Recovery Flow
docs.text:
• Operator taps Forgot Password? on the login ledger.
  • Invokes Amplify.Auth.resetPassword(username: email).
  • Operator enters the emailed reset code alongside their new password to finalize credentials.

docs.title: 4. Native Logout & Session Revocation
docs.text:
• Operator taps REVOKE ALL SESSIONS on the Field Dossier screen.
  • Executes Amplify.Auth.signOut().
  • Purges in-memory and persistent token storage.
  • Resets application state and smoothly routes the operator back to the Clearance Ledger.
  • No external browser redirects: Avoids the deprecated browser-based /logout endpoint, preventing HTTP 400 redirect errors.

docs.title: Session Persistence & Token Refresh
docs.text:
• Automatic Refresh: The Amplify Auth SDK automatically rotates expired access tokens in the background using the Cognito refresh token.
  • Persistent Sessions: Login state survives application restarts, cold boots, and background memory reclamation.
  • Sanitized Display Names: User IDs (Cognito UUIDs) are parsed and sanitized; only researcher handles and formatted call signs (e.g. ARCH-9942) are displayed in the UI.

docs.title: Application Canvases Walkthrough
docs.text: SYNQRA organizes the analyst workflow into dedicated canvases accessible via the brutalist Mini-Dock and tactile page transitions.

docs.title: Purpose & Functionality
docs.text: The application initializes with an interactive typewriter terminal animation designed to set the archival research tone: - Kinetic Typewriter Header: Renders the SYNQRA title character-by-character with a blinking vermilion block cursor (▌). - Telemetry Readout: Simulates real-time system bootstrapping: - MOUNTING LATENT MANIFOLD (1536-D)... [VEC_INIT] - CALIBRATING HNSW GRAPH & BM25 INDICES... [HNSW_CALIB] - ESTABLISHING GROUNDED SSE PIPELINE... [SSE_LINK] - SYNQRA CORE ONLINE // CLEARANCE VERIFIED... [SYS_READY] - Bypass Gesture: Operators can tap the [ SKIP >> ] chip in the upper right quadrant to bypass the animation immediately. - Routing Gate: Evaluates SettingsProvider.isAuthenticated. If the operator has an active session, it navigates directly to RootShellScreen; otherwise, it directs to ClearanceAuthScreen.

docs.title: Purpose & Functionality
docs.text: The primary research work area where operators dispatch natural language queries against dense document stores: - Preset Inquiry Pills: Immediate exploration triggers (What is dense neural IR?, How does cross-encoder reranking work?, Explain 1536-D embedding projections). - Real-Time Token Streaming: Text streams incrementally via Server-Sent Events (POST /questions/stream). - Formatted Markdown & Formulae: Renders complex research prose, lists, code blocks, and mathematical equations with KaTeX. - Interactive Citation Badges: Embedded markers such as [1] and [2] are hyperlinked directly. Tapping a badge triggers the Evidence Bottom Sheet. - Scope Pill Indicator: Bottom bar displays the active query scope (e.g. SCOPE: ALL DATABASE or SCOPE: 2 DOCS SELECTED).

docs.title: Evidence Attribution Bottom Sheet (EvidenceBottomSheet)
docs.text: When an operator taps an inline citation badge: - Displays source document title and file ID. - Surfaces specific page references and cosine relevance scores. - Displays the exact extracted chunk context used by the synthesis generator. - Includes a button to jump directly into the Vector Matrix for raw embedding tensor inspection.

docs.title: Purpose & Functionality
docs.text: Provides complete control over document ingestion, vector indexing, and dynamic query scoping: - Contextual Search: Auto-routes direct questions entered in the corpus search bar to the retrieval engine. - Chunking Strategy Toggle: - SEMANTIC: Sentence-aware dense chunking for complex research documents. - FIXED-SIZE: High-throughput token window chunking skipping sentence embeddings for faster ingest. - Multipart PDF Upload (+ INGEST PDF): Opens the device file picker to stream PDF files to POST /documents. - Slide & Tap Scope Selection: - Tap any card to isolate queries strictly to that document. - Slide vertically across multiple cards to select a contiguous document range. - Toggle ALL to clear filters and query the entire corpus. - Status Ledger: Real-time progress bars and status tags (INDEXED, INDEXING (15%), FAILED).

docs.title: Purpose & Functionality
docs.text: Allows knowledge architects to inspect the underlying high-dimensional vector representations: - 1536-D Projection Explorer: Drill down into chunk references (e.g. chk_784f_neural, chk_993b_rerank). - BM25 Lexical Weighting: Inspect sparse token weights alongside dense vector embeddings for hybrid retrieval analysis. - Chunk Inspector Sub-Canvas (ChunkInspectorScreen): Displays raw chunk text, token distributions, and vector dispersion indices.

docs.title: Purpose & Functionality
docs.text: A comprehensive telemetry cockpit reporting backend performance and retrieval health: - Latency Breakdown: Real-time measurement of total query turnaround (e.g. 167 ms) versus cross-encoder reranking overhead (85 ms). - Manifold Scoring: Cosine similarity metrics (0.928), BM25 sparse scores (12.64), and candidate pruning ratio (16 / 128). - Knowledge Graph Topology: Visual summary of indexed nodes and typed edges across pipelines, embedders, indices, and documents. - Operator Clearance Badge: Quick view of active identity (Reddynithish15, Level-3 Architect) with one-tap access to the Field Dossier. - Active Endpoint Status: Verified link to production HTTPS endpoint (https://synqra-api.duckdns.org/questions/stream). - Theme Switcher: Immediate toggle between Warm Parchment (Light) and Obsidian Nocturne (Dark).

docs.title: 6. Operator Clearance & Field Dossier (UserProfileScreen)
docs.text: Accessible from the top header operator badge or via the VIEW DOSSIER ➔ button on the Telemetry canvas: - Operator Call Sign: Custom researcher handle and level badge. - Vector Quota Meter: Visual percentage indicator tracking monthly embedding and token consumption. - Security Ledger: Active session credentials managed by AWS Cognito SRP. - Session Revocation: REVOKE ALL SESSIONS button executes native Amplify.Auth.signOut(), purges keychain tokens, and securely returns the operator to the Clearance Ledger.

docs.title: AWS CloudWatch Telemetry & Audit Stream
docs.text: SYNQRA integrates a production-grade AWS CloudWatch Logs and Metrics pipeline directly into the Flutter mobile shell. This enables real-time operational auditing, latency monitoring, retrieval scoring telemetry, and compliance tracking across distributed research sessions.

docs.title: Architecture Overview
docs.text:
The telemetry subsystem uses a dual-dispatch architecture: 1. Live AWS SigV4 Dispatch: Requests are signed using aws_signature_v4 and aws_common, targeting CloudWatch endpoints (logs.ap-southeast-2.amazonaws.com) without hardcoded IAM credentials. 2. In-Memory Ring Buffer: Maintains a local circular buffer of the most recent 60 audit records and metrics, guaranteeing instantaneous diagnostics UI inspection and offline resilience if cellular or satellite connectivity drops.

flowchart TD
    subgraph Mobile["SYNQRA Mobile Shell (Flutter)"]
        UI["Diagnostics Canvas / UI"]
        RAG["RagSessionProvider"]
        CORPUS["CorpusProvider"]
        AUTH["SettingsProvider / Cognito"]
        CWS["CloudWatchService"]
        BUFFER[("60-Event In-Memory Ring Buffer")]
        SIGV4["AWSSigV4Signer (aws_signature_v4)"]
    end

    subgraph AWS["Amazon Web Services (ap-southeast-2)"]
        CWL["CloudWatch Logs (/synqra/archival-rag)"]
        CWM["CloudWatch Metrics (Synqra/MobileRetrieval)"]
    end

    RAG -->|"logQuery() / latency & tokens"| CWS
    CORPUS -->|"logIngest() / chunks & strategy"| CWS
    AUTH -->|"logAuth() / sign-in & sign-out"| CWS
    UI -->|"logEvent() / manual audit pulse"| CWS

    CWS -->|"Local mirror (zero network latency)"| BUFFER
    BUFFER -->|"Reactive ticker & status"| UI
    CWS -->|"SigV4 POST / PutLogEvents"| SIGV4
    SIGV4 -->|"HTTPS / ap-southeast-2"| CWL
    SIGV4 -->|"PutMetricData"| CWM

docs.title: Log Event Format
docs.text:
All logs sent to CloudWatch Logs are structured as high-density JSON payloads containing UTC timestamps, log level, message, and metadata:

{
  "timestamp": 1732190400000,
  "message": {
    "timestamp": "2026-11-21T12:00:00.000Z",
    "level": "INFO",
    "message": "RAG query completed successfully",
    "metadata": {
      "prompt_length": 34,
      "latency_ms": 167,
      "tokens_streamed": 42,
      "citations_count": 3,
      "success": true
    }
  }
}

docs.title: Log Levels
docs.text:
• INFO: Normal operational milestones (RAG queries, PDF ingestion, operator sign-in).
  • WARN: User-cancelled streams, retried network attempts, unconfirmed accounts.
  • ERROR: Retrieval failures, backend timeouts, document parsing exceptions.

docs.title: Custom CloudWatch Metrics
docs.text:
The following metrics are published to the Synqra/MobileRetrieval namespace:

Metric Name Unit Dimensions Description QueryLatency Milliseconds Operator, Status Roundtrip latency of grounded RAG query generation TokensStreamed Count Operator Total answer tokens streamed via SSE TotalLatency Milliseconds None Aggregated end-to-end pipeline latency DenseRetrievalScore None None Cosine similarity score of the top dense retrieval candidate SparseBM25Score None None Lexical BM25 score of retrieved chunk matches ChunksIngested Count Strategy Number of chunks produced during PDF corpus ingestion IngestionErrors Count None Corpus ingestion failure count AuditPulsePing Count Operator Manual operator heartbeat / diagnostic ping

docs.title: Security & Identity Federation
docs.text:
[!IMPORTANT] Zero Hardcoded Credentials: SYNQRA never embeds AWS IAM access keys, secret access keys, or bearer tokens in source code or mobile binaries.

  1. Cognito SRP Federation: Users authenticate through AWS Cognito SRP (ap-southeast-2), receiving short-lived JWT tokens (idToken, accessToken, refreshToken).
  2. SigV4 Authorization: Dynamic AWS Signature Version 4 signing is handled by aws_signature_v4, creating AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 headers scoped to ap-southeast-2 and service logs.
  3. Data Sanitization: All logged metadata is sanitized to ensure tokens, passwords, and user passkeys are completely excluded from CloudWatch payloads.

docs.title: Diagnostics UI & Live Inspection
docs.text:
The Telemetry & Graph Diagnostics canvas (lib/presentation/screens/graph_telemetry_screen.dart) provides complete visibility into the CloudWatch subsystem:

  • Dispatch Status Badge:
  • ACTIVE // DUAL-DISPATCH: Actively streaming to CloudWatch in ap-southeast-2.
  • BUFFERING // LOCAL AUDIT RING: Buffering events locally for inspection without network overhead.
  • DISABLED: Telemetry logging paused by operator.
  • Log Stream Details: Displays active Log Group, Region, Stream Name, and total event counter.
  • Recent Audit Logs Ticker: Scrollable live view showing the last 10 audit records with timestamp and level color-coding (Sage for INFO, Amber for WARN, Vermilion for ERROR).
  • Audit Pulse Button: ⚡ DISPATCH CLOUDWATCH AUDIT PULSE sends a verified test record and metric pulse to CloudWatch on demand.

docs.title: Design System & Visual Identity
docs.text: SYNQRA rejects sterile, homogenized design conventions in favor of a Neo-Brutalist Archival aesthetic. The visual language is engineered to feel like an authoritative, high-density scientific instrument.

docs.title: Design Principles
docs.text:
1. Tactile Brutalism: High-contrast solid borders (1.5px - 2.5px) paired with hard-edge directional drop shadows (Offset(3, 3)) with zero gaussian blur.
  2. Archival Typography: High-character editorial slab-serifs for headlines paired with monospaced precision for technical readouts and latency data.
  3. Information Density: Maximum screen utilization with structured modular cards, progress bars, and metadata chips.
  4. Zero Blurry Bitmaps: Vector canvas rendering throughout with crisp vector glyphs and typography.

docs.title: Typography Hierarchy
docs.text:
• Display & Headings: GoogleFonts.fraunces() / GoogleFonts.newsreader() — Editorial slab-serif character with fallback to system serif and Times New Roman.
  • Telemetry & Readouts: GoogleFonts.jetBrainsMono() — Monospaced fixed-width precision for latency metrics, hashes, and vector coordinates.
  • Reading Body: Standard serif with generous line height (1.55) for readable research synthesis.

docs.title: Brutalist Shadow Physics
docs.text:
Containers in SYNQRA utilize hard-edge directional drop shadows implemented via AppTheme.brutalistShadow():

static List<BoxShadow> brutalistShadow(
  Color borderColor, {
  Offset offset = const Offset(3, 3),
}) {
  return [
    BoxShadow(
      color: borderColor,
      offset: offset,
      blurRadius: 0, // Zero blur creates the iconic brutalist edge
    ),
  ];
}

docs.title: Android 12+ Adaptive Launcher Icons
docs.text: The application includes custom-engineered vector adaptive icons: - Foreground: Tactile SYNQRA monogram on geometric lattice (adaptive_foreground.png). - Monochrome: Android 13+ material themed monochrome mask (adaptive_monochrome.png). - Background Sync: Splash and launch window background synchronized to #F5EFE6 to ensure zero launch flicker.

docs.title: Getting Started & Deployment
docs.text: This guide covers setting up your local Flutter development environment, configuring backend endpoints, and deploying SYNQRA to physical devices and emulators.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Flutter SDK: >=3.7.0 (flutter.dev)
  • Dart SDK: >=3.7.0
  • Android Studio / Android SDK: Platform API 34+
  • Physical Device or Emulator: Google Pixel 8 Pro recommended
  • Java: OpenJDK 17+

docs.title: 1. Clone & Resolve Dependencies
docs.text:
Clone the repository and install all Flutter packages:

git clone https://github.com/your-username/Flutter-Project.git
cd Flutter-Project

# Resolve Dart dependencies
flutter pub get

docs.title: Default Production Backend
docs.text:
By default, the application is pre-configured to communicate with the live production HTTPS service: 

https://synqra-api.duckdns.org
No extra networking steps are required when using the production backend.

docs.title: Local Development Backend (FastAPI on Port 8000)
docs.text:
If developing against a locally running FastAPI instance, reverse-forward host port 8000 via ADB so the Android client can access http://localhost:8000:

# Verify connected physical device
adb devices

# Reverse port forwarding for FastAPI server
adb reverse tcp:8000 tcp:8000

# Verify endpoint accessibility
curl http://localhost:8000/documents

docs.title: Run in Debug Mode
docs.text:
Launch the application with hot-reload enabled: 

flutter run

docs.title: Build Debug APK
docs.text:
Generate an unsigned debug APK for testing: 

flutter build apk --debug
Output artifact located at: 
build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk

docs.title: Install Directly via ADB (Google Pixel 8 Pro)
docs.text:
# Install to connected device
adb install -r build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-debug.apk

# Force-stop and launch main activity
adb shell am force-stop com.example.my_flutter_proj_dq
adb shell am start -n com.example.my_flutter_proj_dq/.MainActivity

docs.title: Build Release APK
docs.text:
flutter build apk --release
Output artifact located at: 
build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk

docs.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
docs.text: SYNQRA enforces automated testing across all layers to ensure streaming stability, robust regex citation parsing, correct AWS Cognito state transitions, and responsive brutalist layouts.

docs.title: Running Verification Suites
docs.text:
# 1. Static code analysis (0 warnings / 0 errors)
flutter analyze

# 2. Automated test suite (All tests passing)
flutter test

docs.title: Test Coverage Breakdown
docs.text: Test File Focus Area Verified Scenarios test/cognito_auth_test.dart AWS Cognito SRP Authentication Sign-in with valid SRP credentials, confirmation challenges, session refresh, sanitized researcher names, and native logout without browser redirects. test/rag_stream_repository_test.dart Server-Sent Events Protocol Chunk decoding, status event mapping, cancellation handling, 404 stream fallback, and HTTP errors. test/rag_session_provider_test.dart Stream State Machine Transitions (idle → streaming → completed), incremental token concatenation, and step duration counters. test/corpus_selection_test.dart Multi-Document Selection Single-card tapping, multi-card slide range selection, selectAll, clearSelection, and query scoping payloads. test/corpus_repository_test.dart Multipart Uploads & Cache Multipart file serialization, SharedPreferences manifest persistence, and upload progress polling. test/citation_parser_test.dart Citation Regex Parsing Identification of [1], [2], [1, 2] patterns, text span chunking, and click-to-preview attribution binding. test/formatted_answer_test.dart Markdown & KaTeX Rendering Markdown formatting, KaTeX equation parsing, and interactive badge taps. test/splash_screen_test.dart Kinetic Typewriter Animation Character-by-character timer, blinking cursor state, [ SKIP >> ] bypass trigger, and navigation gate. test/cloudwatch_service_test.dart AWS CloudWatch Telemetry JSON payload serialization, metric data points, dynamic stream naming, 60-event in-memory ring buffer, SigV4 PutLogEvents request signing, and disabled state isolation. test/widget_test.dart End-to-End Widget Shell 4-canvas navigation container, Archival Clearance Ledger, and User Profile Dossier.
